title: Neuro Rehabilitation Support Worker
description:
Neuro Rehabilitation Support Worker

Location: Rotherham

Salary: £13.45 per hour

Contract Type: Bank (occasional), Part-Time and Full-Time Opportunities Available

Join a Team Where You Can Truly Make a Difference

At Ariya Neuro Care, we believe that rehabilitation is about more than recovery. It's about helping people rediscover confidence, independence, purpose, and hope following a life-changing brain injury.

We're looking for kind, positive, and enthusiastic people to join our outstanding team in Rotherham. Whether you're experienced in care, looking for a complete career change, or seeking valuable experience within a therapeutic environment, we'd love to hear from you.

If you're someone who enjoys helping others, values teamwork, and wants a role where every day brings something new, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

About the Role

As a Neuro Rehabilitation Support Worker, you'll play an important part in supporting individuals as they work towards their rehabilitation goals and rebuild their lives following an acquired brain injury.

Working closely with our specialist neurotherapy team, you'll help people develop skills, gain confidence, and achieve greater independence in a warm and supportive environment.

The role includes:
- Supporting rehabilitation programmes and individual goals
- Encouraging independence and confidence
- Assisting with daily living activities and routines
- Working collaboratively with therapists and colleagues
- Supporting social, leisure, and community activities
- Providing personal care when required
- Helping create a positive and encouraging environment where people can thrive

Who We're Looking For

We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and life experiences. Most importantly, we're looking for individuals who share our values and genuinely enjoy helping others succeed.

You may be a great fit if you are:
- Kind, caring, and compassionate
- Positive, enthusiastic, and encouraging
- A team player who enjoys working collaboratively
- Adaptable and enjoys variety in your work
- Interested in rehabilitation and helping people achieve their goals
- Eager to learn and develop new skills
- Practical, proactive, and supportive in your approach

Previous care experience is not essential, as we provide comprehensive training, mentoring, and ongoing support. What matters most is your attitude, commitment, and desire to make a positive impact.

Why Join Ariya Neuro Care?

We are incredibly proud of the environment we've created for both the people we support and the colleagues who work with us.

Our services have achieved the rare distinction of being rated 'Outstanding' across all areas by CQC, reflecting the exceptional outcomes achieved through our compassionate and person-centred approach.

We have also been awarded the prestigious Platinum Investors in People Accreditation, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing our staff.

When you join our team, you'll benefit from:
- Full induction and specialist training
- Ongoing mentoring and professional support
- Opportunities for career progression
- Leadership and management development programmes
- The chance to work alongside highly skilled neurotherapy professionals
- A genuinely supportive, friendly, and collaborative team culture

Working Pattern

This role operates on a rota basis and includes:
- Day, evening, and weekend shifts
- All aspects of personal care
- Opportunities for bank, part-time, and full-time working

Benefits
- Employee mentoring programme
- Free flu vaccinations
- Free parking
- Health and wellbeing programme
- On-site parking
- Employee discount scheme
- Referral programme

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Ariya Neuro Care, please do not hesitate to apply.
